test_title: PYST 58: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 23 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: OPNO is related to STRS in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, DECD is related to HIGH. To which of the given optuons is JKIJ related, following the same logic?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a2ad970d69a7d5a698e2a244921bc77b73c5728413196627b214589318ffed6.png] Logic followed here is: Each letter of the first word is shifted by +4 positions in the English alphabetical order to obtain the corresponding letter of the second word. **For** **OPNO is related to STRS →**
